subject: design-technology

items.q: Which comes first in the 6 Rs of sustainability?
items.correct: Reduce and reuse come before recycling.
items.misconception: Recycling is always the best first option.
items.why: The 6 Rs prioritise using less and reusing before recycling, which still uses energy.

items.q: Does mass production cost the same per item as one-off making?
items.correct: No — mass production lowers the cost per item.
items.misconception: Yes, both cost the same per unit.
items.random_wrong: One-off (bespoke) production is the cheapest per item.
items.why: Higher volumes spread costs, reducing the unit price; bespoke items are expensive per item.
